Description: A visual approximation of Kerr black-hole frame dragging, photon-ring rotation, and relativistic vertical warp.
KScript: var spin := clamp(v0, -0.99, 0.99); var radius := sqrt(x*x + y*y + 0.01); var horizon := max(v1, 1.0); var drag := (2.0 * spin * horizon) / (radius*radius*radius + 0.01); var angle := t * v2 * drag + u * v3; var c := cos(angle); var s := sin(angle); var ox := x; var oy := y; x := ox*c - oy*s; y := ox*s + oy*c; z += sin(t*v2 + radius*v4) * v5 / (radius + 1.0); rz += angle * rad;
